actions.action: Conduct a comprehensive visual inspection and thermography scan of the cable connections and wiring to identify degradation or hot spots.
actions.expected_impact: Early detection of cable degradation will help prevent severe incidents and reduce the 34.4% of the equipment cost associated with this failure mode.

actions.action: Implement a regular schedule for cleaning PV modules, especially after moderate rain, to prevent dirt accumulation that could contribute to superficial damages.
actions.expected_impact: Maintaining clean modules will mitigate superficial damages, which account for 24.7% of the equipment cost and are linked to incidents under windy and stormy conditions.

actions.action: Perform detailed IV-curve tracing and insulation resistance tests on the PV inverter and upstream DC field to detect early electrical faults and insulation issues.
actions.expected_impact: Early electrical fault detection will help prevent performance drops, although this failure mode has no recent recurrence within 90 days.

actions.action: Check and tighten all connector torque settings, and replace any connectors showing signs of wear or corrosion, especially in areas exposed to environmental stress.
actions.expected_impact: Proper connector maintenance will reduce the risk of connector failures, which have no recent severe incidents but are linked to environmental stress.

actions.action: Inspect and verify the operation of surge protection devices regularly to prevent internal faults or overheating that could lead to fire incidents.
actions.expected_impact: Regular inspection will help mitigate fire risks, which have a recurrence within 90 days and account for 12% of the equipment cost.

actions.action: Establish a scheduled cleaning and inspection routine for the PV modules to minimize dirt accumulation and mechanical impacts, especially after storm events.
actions.expected_impact: Routine cleaning will help prevent damages and reduce the risk of incidents related to dirt and mechanical impacts, although this failure mode has no recent severe incidents.

actions.action: Conduct a fire risk assessment focusing on internal faults and overheating sources, independent of weather conditions, to identify potential hazards early.
actions.expected_impact: Proactive fire risk management aims to prevent severe incidents and recurrences, which have a significant impact on safety and costs.
